description: This walk follows a section of the Wales Coast Path from Criccieth to Pwllheli. The route runs for about 11 miles along the well signposted path with some splendid coastal views and fine beaches along the way. Starting from Criccieth, with its imposing castle as a backdrop, the path heads west, often following the coastline with views across the bays. Later you'll pass along the lovely beaches and sand dunes at Morfa Abererch. As you approach Pwllheli, the path leads along the expansive Pwllheli Marina, one of the largest in Wales. The final stretch brings you into the bustling market town of Pwllheli, with its harbor, beaches, and town centre.
